# Visualizations

This folder contains specific visual analysis elements and graphical representations extracted from the Danish Acute Surgery Database reports. It currently documents a supplementary graph tracking the temporal development of open surgical procedures across different Danish regions, which serves as a benchmarking tool to support clinical and political decision-making. The pages here capture the explicit mentions, analytical purpose, and contextual role of these visualizations within the broader quantitative reporting.

## Pages

- [[supplerende-graf-med-aaben-kirurgi-over-tid-paa-regionalt-niveau|Supplerende graf med åben kirurgi over tid på regionalt niveau]] — A supplementary visual analysis element illustrating the temporal development of open surgeries across Danish regions to support clinical benchmarking.
